name: hydraulic-line
why: Routed tube in a real part: three 90 degree bends of one radius, bored along the same route, with a boss at each end and an O-ring groove turned into the inlet boss. The two-rim selector is what says the bore still runs the whole route — a bend radius that stopped fitting would break the chain and leave a different number. The groove took 178.78 mm3 out of the 19340.75 the part measured without it, against 179.90 by Pappus: 0.6% under, which is tessellation under-reading a 1 mm concave radius and is the direction that error must have. It is also the shape that used to segfault UnifySameDomain in a cylinder wall, so a part carrying it is a second, in-context guard on the OCCT 8.0.1 fix that torus-gland holds directly.
